title: Automatic Design of Optimization Test Problems with Large Language Models

mechanism.domainTask: Evolutionary generation of continuous optimization benchmark functions matching target ELA features
mechanism.populationDetail: The paper refers to multiple generated functions in population history and a save-and-reuse loop, but does not specify the pool's structure or size.
mechanism.archiveDetail: Candidate history is reused, but no separate elite archive or elite admission rule is described.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The high-level figure shows generated candidates being saved; the paper does not report survivor filtering, archive update logic, or whether the saved history is bounded.
mechanism.generationDetail: I1 and E1/E2 generate without an editable parent (E1/E2 use prior functions as context), while M1-M3 modify one selected parent.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: The evaluator computes a vector of ELA features and scalar distance, but the paper does not show candidate-specific feature vectors being inserted into later prompts; scalar fitness guides candidate comparison.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: The number of true parents varies by operator: initialization/exploration have none, and mutation has one. Sampling policy for the mutation parent is unspecified.

provenance.sourcePdf: papers/Automatic Design of Optimization Test Problems with Large Language Models.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: The paper describes the operator portfolio but not the operator-selection policy, population capacity/survival, or parent-sampling rule. The 100-sample repeated evaluation is an external robustness comparison protocol and may not apply to each search-loop evaluation. Current survey Chapters 3-7 do not cite EoTF; the placements above are recommendations based on paper mechanisms.
